Tile motion in the pairs is mostly cuts between positions and fades; little visible ease, overshoot or settle.
gaps: Motion: the piano-roll-to-wordmark idea is strong, but the hand-off is a dissolve-and-scatter, not choreography. Each tile should travel along its pitch row with eased arrivals, overlap and a weighted lock into the letterform. The peak (~5s) arrives at mid-point and is followed by an empty black beat instead of a build to 70% and a release.

Sound: sparse plucked synth notes with few partials and short static decays, then a few broadband hits from ~6.2s. It is thin and reads as generated. Note onsets are not clearly tied to individual tiles landing, which is the obvious payoff for a music-festival note grid.

Finish: flat vector fills under a global grain filter, with no light, depth or material response. The assembly frames have messy transitional states (ghost alphas, shards). The black mid-section breaks the otherwise consistent blue/orange system without earning it.
